• Distância mínima: rotas mais curtas qu:
• Minimum distance: routes shorter than this (e.g. within the same orbit) count as if they had this distance in the efficiency calculation, because taking off, landing and loading also take time. Increase it if routes that are too short show up at the top.

• Routes analyzed: the N most profitable routes get distance, efficiency and risk. More routes = more complete result, but the first search takes a bit longer (distances are kept for 12 h).
